description: Announced acquisitions, recapitalisations and exits by independent sponsors: sponsor, target, dates, enterprise value range where disclosed, structure, parties and source. Filter by sponsor, target, type, state, since-date or name text.

query.description: Matches the sponsor's or the target's name.

sponsor_dfx_id.description: A DFX id: dfx:fo:<uuid> (family office graph), dfx:isi:<uuid> (sponsor graph), dfx:vc:<uuid> (venture graph), dfx:pe:<uuid> (private equity graph), dfx:ria:<uuid> (registered investment adviser graph), dfx:al:<uuid> (allocator graph), dfx:pc:<uuid> (private credit graph), dfx:ref:<uuid> (real estate fund graph), or a bare real estate UUID.
